reasoning_traces.think:
The core methodology combines visual perception with reinforcement learning to evaluate soccer players. Entity tracking uses SSD to localize players, ball, and referees. Homography estimation infers 3D layout from 2D views using ResNet-18 and EfficientNet-b3. Keypoint segmentation provides precise body part localization. These inputs feed into a re-identification system using ResNet-50 embeddings. The EDG agent operates in a simulated football environment, learning to maximize discounted future goals without real-world data. The tracking pipeline is soccer-specific but the EDG framework generalizes to other domains. Failure modes include occlusion, lighting variation, and misalignment in keypoint labeling. The system assumes consistent object behavior and sufficient visual resolution for accurate inference.
